{{Youmay|the organization on Dellalt|[[Survivors (disambiguation)|other uses of the term]]}}
The '''Survivors''' were a group of individuals descended from the honor guard of the [[Queen of Ranroon/Legends|''Queen of Ranroon'']]. They existed on [[Dellalt/Legends|Dellalt]], maintaining the [[Guardian Corps]] of [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot]].<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Dwelling in a hidden mountain fortress, they became severely inbred over the course of twenty-five thousand years. Using [[hypno-imprinting]], the Survivors would brainwash their children into loyalty and maintaining technology they barely understood. They maintained a belief that they would eventually be rescued by Xim's revived High Command, and developed a cult that believed sentient sacrifice would boost their distress signal. Elite members of the Survivors knew the cult to be a sham and integrated with Dellaltian society, secretly guarding the secret of Xim's treasure vaults.<ref name="Han Solo and the Lost Legacy">''[[Han Solo and the Lost Legacy]]''</ref> The Survivors wore elaborately decorated uniforms and headgear which featured antennas and motherboards etched with arcane glyphs.
